description: This file defines a utility class BeanUtils that provides methods for retrieving property values from Java beans using reflection and introspection.

classes.name: BeanUtils
classes.description: A utility class for accessing property values of Java bean objects using reflection.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of BeanUtils.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from a given Java bean object, utilizing introspection to find and call the property's getter method.

methods.name: getPropertyDescriptor
methods.description: Helper method that uses Introspector to get the PropertyDescriptor for a specific property name in a bean class.
